An incoming nested class-formal List supplies a public nullary integer getter
inside a new object's argument evaluation before a typed constructor delegation.
Source and SDK-context profiles compile every Java unit and compare original
entries, fields, metadata and Exceptions. Frozen direct, separately compiled,
reflection and method-handle callers observe class initialization before the
getter, arbitrary integer snapshots, mutable contents, fresh identities,
partial fields, exact failures and late casts. The matrix has 96 fresh JVM

Use JDK 25 for recovered constructor prologues and release 8 for originals.
